latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Text to Video Free App version 1.0.0

- Converts text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 200MB) into ready-to-share 1080p videos.
- No local install needed; runs entirely on cloud GPUs with typical processing time of 1–2 minutes per video.
- Simple setup: auto-connects using a free anonymous token if needed.
- Supports video edits, previewing timeline, background music, text overlays, and exporting in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, GIF, etc.).
- Clear API routing for user actions like export, upload, credit checks, and session management.
- Designed for content creators seeking fast, shareable videos from written content.
